not_found.place: Khartoum hospital site (Early Khartoum type site)
not_found.reason: GHA I p.720 (ch.28) says only 'a site in Khartoum itself', and p.642 (ch.25) 'the excavations at Khartoum'. The word 'hospital' does not occur in GHA I. Arkell's Early Khartoum (1949) and Shaheinab (1953) are not open access (OUP; only paywalled reviews found). Krzyżaniak's open PAM 1 (1990) pp.26–28 report on Kadero gives no coordinates, and the Heidelberg Propylaeum Kadero volume (which states coordinates) was behind a bot wall and was not read. No point is given and no town coordinate is inferred.
